skill_yaml:
skill: obstacle_reach
phases:
- id: approach_1
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: force_threshold_switch
  termination: pose_tolerance
  parameters:
    approach_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.1
      - 0.3
    arc_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.32
      - 0.5
- id: descend_1
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: admittance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  parameters:
    depth:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1

skill: obstacle_reach
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: reach_high
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - 0.4
  weight: 0.3
- id: reach_goal
  weight: 0.7
phases:
- id: arc_approach
  type: approach
  generator: arc_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.4
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    arc_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.1
      - 0.4
      default: 0.25
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.arc_height
        mode: replace
    lift_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.3
      - 0.5
      default: 0.4
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
    speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.5
      default: 0.2
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: reach_high
- id: descend_to_goal
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.5
      default: 0.2
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: reach_goal
